title: Resilient Checkpoint Coordination for Synthetic HPC Workloads
core_argument: In the supplied 128-node synthetic stencil workload, coordinating incremental checkpoints reduced measured checkpoint interruption while preserving recovery coverage.

must_have: The central performance claim is limited to the supplied 128-node synthetic scenario.
All evidence is drawn from the closed-world fixture corpus (benchmark-observations.md).
No statistical significance is claimed and no external literature is cited.
should_have: The two background examples are ordered by editorial discretion without changing the argument.
Recovery coverage is reported for every recorded trial in the fixture.
out_of_scope: External literature search and citation selection (deferred until network access is separately approved).
Statistical significance testing, variance, confidence intervals, energy measurements, scaling results, or independent replication.
